title: Comprehensive Japanese capability assessment
rawUserRequest: Execute the approved AI Cockpit remediation plan serially. Before publishing a new version, perform a comprehensive Japanese capability assessment. Japanese capability is mandatory; every finding requires a corresponding corrective Work Item and remains blocking until corrected and re-evaluated.

rawRequestSource.reference: user authorization: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation continuation and mandatory Japanese release gate

declaredIntent.summary: Measure the repository-governance paths that Japanese-speaking engineers depend on, expose unsupported claims, and keep release blocked for every unresolved Japanese handling gap.

outOfScope: Claiming general model fluency or provider-specific Japanese quality from deterministic repository tests
Changing runtime security, identity, isolation, signing, branch protection, or enterprise compliance
Publishing a release or changing Capability Truth statuses without new evidence
Implementing the WI-17 multilingual Human-Agent Trust Layer documents
Deleting or rewriting archived Work Item evidence

sources.reason: WI-16 mandatory Japanese gate, scope, sequence, and corrective Work Item rule.
Deterministic source/trust/authority and Japanese injection boundary.
Existing source and high-risk re-evaluation behavior.
Existing Japanese, mixed-language, hidden HTML, Base64, Unicode, and nested-quote corpus.
Japanese engineer entry path and product boundary.
Only source of current capability status.
Closed predecessor baseline and known open release/documentation evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: A false Japanese pass could expose Japanese-speaking engineers to untranslated or incorrectly classified stop conditions before release.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly authorized serial execution and made Japanese capability a mandatory pre-release gate.

preReviewWarnings: Deterministic local tests prove only the bounded repository behavior they execute; they must not be reported as general Japanese model fluency.
Any failed, ambiguous, unverified, stale, or English-only inferred Japanese scenario is blocking and requires a corrective Work Item before this Work Item can close.

checkpointPolicy.reason: High-risk language coverage and release gating require checkpoints before edits and finish.

acceptance: A deterministic Japanese capability matrix covers input handling, technical/mixed language, injection, unknown/human confirmation, stop/recovery semantics, repository documents, and output parity.
Every matrix result includes source evidence, test or command evidence, limitations, and a reproducible digest.
Japanese injection and high-risk operation tests remain fail-closed and do not promote untrusted content to authority.

Any missing or unsupported Japanese capability within the declared repository-governance scope is recorded as blocking and receives a named corrective Work Item; no unresolved finding is hidden by a pass label.
The Japanese assessment report and the remediation plan are aligned, and limitations explicitly exclude unproved general model fluency.
guidelines: Japanese-speaking engineers are a required audience; do not infer Japanese capability from English-only tests.
Evidence over self-declaration: every result is bound to a source and executable evidence.
Keep release, identity, isolation, and enterprise compliance claims outside this local assessment unless delegated evidence exists.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The repository already has Japanese documentation and Japanese prompt-injection examples, but release readiness requires a consolidated assessment of whether Japanese engineers receive the same safe, actionable, and fail-closed governance behavior across the supported paths.
constraints: Use deterministic local evidence only for repository behavior.
Keep unresolved general-language capability limitations visible.
Do not publish or alter external release evidence in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: A bounded, reproducible matrix can distinguish tested Japanese governance behavior from unproven general language ability and make every release blocker actionable.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized the complete serial remediation plan and explicitly required the Japanese release gate.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore the prior assessment/report while retaining the immutable archived evidence.
